messages:
ana: Quick follow-up from PM-2026 action list I want to confirm owners for alert prioritization + dedupe work so we don't drop this between sprints.

pat: I can own the prioritization matrix. Plan: audit current alerts that paged >3x in 30 days and label them by impact/business-scope. ETA Tue EOD.

diego: I'll take dedupe implementation and paging-policy rules. Implementation notes: use alert fingerprint = service+metric+shard, backfill 90d to verify collisions. PR ETA: Thu.

morgan: Thanks. Two asks: 1) For any alert we lower sensitivity on, add a fallback rule that pages if downstream error-rate spikes >3% within 10m. 2) Capture the before/after paging counts for 30d so we can validate we reduced noise without missing incidents.

pat: Agreed. I'll add a column in the matrix for "fallback required" and mark owners. Also will add a priority score so we can defer low-impact noisy alerts.

ops-bot: Incident summary: last 60d, noisy alerts flagged: 18 alerts, 72 pages, 40% associated with synthetic jobs or deploys.

ana: (typo) 

ana: ^ meant to say: noted.

diego: For the dedupe rollout I propose a staged approach: staging validation -> canary (10% services) -> global. Also will add telemetry: dedupe_suppressed_count and dedupe_false_positive_count. If false positive >2% in canary, auto-revert.

pat: Good guardrails. For prioritization, I'll tag each alert as P0/P1/P2 and set suggested tuning: threshold, window, dedupe key, and whether it should page or go to digest.

morgan: Put all PRs and the matrix link here. I'll update PM action items and close after we verify 14 days of stable paging reduction. If any owner needs more time, post the reason + new ETA here.

ops-bot: Reminder: @diego is primary oncall Fri-Sun. Avoid pushing global changes right before weekend unless coordinated.

diego: Noted. I'll aim to land canary Fri 12:00 UTC and monitor for 6h, then escalate to global Sat 14:00 UTC if green.

pat: Matrix draft: https://docs.redwood/internals/alert-prio-matrix (comments enabled).

morgan: Closing loop: owners/ETAs summary -> pat: prioritization matrix, 2025-01-14; diego: dedupe & canary rollout, 2025-01-16; morgan: validation and post-change metrics, 2025-01-30. I'll tick items off once evidence is attached. :white_check_mark:
